meta.title: Security architecture | DencPass
meta.description: AES-256-GCM encryption, zero-knowledge architecture, 2FA TOTP, HIBP breach detection. Security you can audit.

hero.title: Zero knowledge, No compromises
hero.subtitle: Your data is encrypted on your device before it ever reaches us. Our servers store unreadable blocks: we can't read your secrets, even if we wanted to.

step1.title: On your device
step1.desc: Input is encrypted locally with your key, derived from your master password.

step2.title: In transit
step2.desc: Only already-encrypted blocks travel, protected end-to-end by TLS.

step3.title: At rest
step3.desc: Our servers store unreadable data, each entry encrypted separately.

step4.title: On read
step4.desc: Decryption only ever happens on your device, never server-side.

aes.title: AES-256-GCM per entry
aes.desc: Every password, secret and certificate is individually encrypted, with an HMAC integrity check.

zeroKnowledge.title: Zero knowledge
zeroKnowledge.desc: Your key never leaves your device. Even with physical access to the server, your data stays unreadable.

totp.title: 2FA TOTP
totp.desc: Compatible with Google Authenticator and Authy. The TOTP secret itself is encrypted at rest.

rotation.title: Key rotation
rotation.desc: Keys can be renewed with zero service interruption and no manual re-authentication.

audit.title: Full audit trail
audit.desc: Every action is logged and exportable to Splunk, Elastic or Wazuh via webhook or Syslog RFC 5424.

leaks.title: Breach detection
leaks.desc: Checked against 700M+ known breaches (HIBP) via k-anonymity: your password never leaves your device in clear text.

cta.title: Security you can audit
cta.subtitle: Create your encrypted vault for free, or talk to our team about your compliance requirements.
